technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term bullish momentum (AO cross-up, OBV rising) conflicted by overbought stochastic, weak trend strength (ADX 22.88), and bearish long-term structure below 200-MA; moderate risk swing entry with limited upside confirmation.

fundamental.summary: ROK shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 50 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (21/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; mixed signals warrant caution.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (304), rising dollar, imminent CPI event, and negative macro score (-8) create hostile environment for industrials; earnings in 50 days adds execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (AO cross-up, OBV rising, Supertrend bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (21/100) creates contrarian entry near support (239.51) in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish long-term structure (below 200-MA, EMA 50/200 bearish), weak trend confirmation (ADX 22.88), overbought stochastic, crisis macro environment (inverted yield curve, VIX 304), zero fundamental support, and earnings risk in 50 days overwhelm short-term signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (AO cross-up, OBV rising) and extreme fear sentiment (21/100) create contrarian setup at support, but bearish long-term structure and crisis macro environment eliminate conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis (304), and earnings in 50 days create hostile macro backdrop that will likely override short-term technical bounce; position already exists, adding concentration risk.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical bullish short-term vs. fundamental/macro/risk bearish long-term
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ROK with 45 existing Industrials positions (13% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further; skip new entry.
